value.body: A science degree in matter and its reactions: organic, inorganic, physical and analytical chemistry, with substantial lab work and supporting Physics, Mathematics or Biology. It leads to pharmaceutical, chemical and materials industries, quality-control and testing labs, teaching and research.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in the science stream, usually with Chemistry and either Mathematics or Biology, plus Physics. Central universities (Delhi University, BHU and others) admit through CUET-UG scores in the relevant subjects; many state universities and their colleges admit on Class 12 merit or a state test. You usually choose the major — or a combination of two or three subjects — at admission.

value.title: At a glance
items: Entry jobs are often in quality control, production or analytical labs in pharma and chemical companies.
Research and R&D roles commonly expect an M.Sc or PhD.
IIT JAM (Chemistry paper) and CUET-PG lead to M.Sc seats.
Government routes include general-graduate exams and, after a master's, scientific and teaching posts.
